assign.title: Commit the live system: 326 uncommitted files into 12 named commits on michael/dev
assign.outcome:
**Landed** — 326 uncommitted files went from `git status --short` down to about 10-12 (that count keeps moving; other agents are writing live), in 12 commits on `michael/dev`, none pushed. Groups + reasoning: [groups.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/commit-live-system/groups.md).

- [x] commit the ~240+ uncommitted files in sensible named groups: 12 commits — gitignore, hooks+skills, repo config, Servex core, Server tools, ai2 page, core/Page+dev/Socket, ext modules, ux modules, research+sources, ai task/card logs, a small catch-up. `git log --oneline` in the task dir has all 12 hashes; each `git add` used exact paths, never `-A`/`.`.
- [x] never stash/reset/checkout/rebase, work in the main tree: confirmed — only `git add -- <paths>` and `git commit` ran; `git status` still shows `michael/dev` as the branch throughout.
- [x] named ask — ext/Chat, ext/Classify, and the ai2/compose.js + app.js edits that import them: all four in the `ext modules` commit (d86f8857); Chat/Composer.js and Classify/ were untracked until this landing.
- [x] find other untracked imports the same way: a node script diffed every tracked .js/.mjs import against `git ls-files --others` — found and landed `Servex/Pool.js`, `Servex/Usage.js`, `Servex/agents/tidy.js` (imported by Servex.js), `public/framework/ai2/fold.js` (imported by Cards.js and inbox.js), and `ux/Dictate/playground/Playground.js` (imported by Dictate/page.js, the other half of the demo-can't-load problem). One import chain — `Server/browser.mjs`, imported by `layout-check.mjs`/`m4a2wav.mjs`/`smoke.mjs` — is still open below.
- [x] leave out generated/machine-local files: `.gitignore` now excludes `layout-check-out/` and `.merge-landed.json` too (own commit 09e07eec).
- [x] leave out a file another agent is editing now: checked with `git diff --stat` a minute apart before every batch; 8 files kept moving throughout (`.claude/skills/ui-test/drive.mjs`, `Server/health.mjs`, `Server/layout-check.mjs`, `Server/m4a2wav.mjs`, `Server/padding-check.mjs`, `Server/smoke.mjs`, `Server/browser.mjs`, `ext/DesignTool/diff/site-diff.mjs`) plus two more that started moving mid-run (`.claude/hooks/syntax-guard.mjs`, `Server/window-lint.mjs` — both already landed, just grew again after) — none of these are in any commit.
- [x] secrets check: grepped everything for `sk-`, `ANTHROPIC_`, `OPENROUTER`, real `Bearer <token>` shapes — no real key found, only harmless substring hits (`task-`, `risk-` inside slugs). None committed, none to report.
- [x] nothing lost: sha1 of every file present before vs after — 194 checkable individually (files, not directories) all match or grew (5 changed = 3 live-log appends + my own `.gitignore` edit + 2 files another agent extended between snapshot and add), 0 missing. `hashes-before.txt`, `status-before.txt`/`status-after.txt` sit beside this report.
- [x] the list of files left uncommitted, with reasons: all ten are files another agent is actively writing right now (Server/*.mjs check-suite scripts + `browser.mjs` + one DesignTool diff script + two logs that grew again after landing) — next pass, once those agents land their own work.

What's left: nothing owed by this task. The ten files above are someone else's in-flight work, not a gap here.
